Smart Entry & Start System
The Smart Entry & Start System is used to dramatically improve convenience and to showcase advanced technology.
The Smart Entry & Start System allows various controls to be performed without handling the electronic key, based on the result of electronic ID code verification by wireless communication between the electronic key and the vehicle.
A warning function is provided to warn in advance of several problems that can occur when the user becomes less conscious of carrying the electronic key, providing excellent usability.
A key cancel function is provided so that the user can stop the Smart Entry & Start System control as desired. When canceled, Smart Entry & Start System control stops, but door lock/unlock by the wireless door lock/unlock function does not stop.
An identification code registration function is used, allowing multiple electronic keys to be used.
The electronic key emits weak radio waves. Persons using a pacemaker should check the instruction manual of the pacemaker before use.
Persons using an implanted cardiac pacemaker or implanted defibrillator should not come within approximately 22cm of the outside antennas or inside antennas. The radio waves may affect the operation of implanted cardiac pacemakers and implanted defibrillators.
The smart function does not operate under the following conditions.
When smart control has been canceled with the key cancel function
When the electronic key battery is depleted (the indicator light does not blink/illuminate when any button on the key is pressed)
Door Lock Functions of the Smart Entry & Start System
Main Function Function Outline
Door Unlock Function A function that unlocks the doors (back door) when the front door outside handle is gripped (the back door opener switch is pressed) and outside verification is OK.
Door Lock Function A function that locks the doors (back door) when the lock switch (back door lock switch) is pressed and outside verification is OK.
Ignition Function A function that changes the power mode and starts the engine through a combined operation of the engine switch and brake pedal when inside verification is OK (when the key battery is depleted, hold the electronic key in front of the engine switch).
Illumination Function A function that illuminates each illumination light when outside verification is OK.
Warning Function A function that sounds warnings to prevent situations in which the user becomes unaware of the electronic key.
Function to Prevent Locking the Electronic Key in the Cabin A function that prevents the key from being locked in by sounding the wireless answer-back buzzer when an attempt is made to lock the doors with the Smart Entry & Start System door lock function while the electronic key is in the cabin.
Power Saving Function A function that extends the interval of or stops the periodic transmission of request signals when the vehicle is not used for a long period, preventing battery discharge.
Key Cancel Function A function that stops Smart Entry & Start System control when a certain operation is performed.
Immobiliser Function A function that permits the engine to be started only with pre-registered electronic keys, preventing unauthorized engine starting.
Smart Entry & Start System Components 1
Smart Entry & Start System Main Component Functions 1
Components Main Function
Certification ECU
Identifies and verifies the ID code from the door control receiver and sends signals to each ECU according to the function to be performed. (Controls the entire system)
Sends request codes to each oscillator.
Performs encrypted code communication with the ID code box during ignition operation.
Sounds the wireless answer-back buzzer during answer-back. [Answer-back Function]
Engine ECU
Receives the engine start request signal from the main body ECU and starts the engine.
Indoor Antenna (Front/Rear)
Transmits the request code from the certification ECU, forming a detection area in the cabin.
Door Control Receiver
Receives the Smart Entry & Start System transmission code/wireless transmission code from the electronic key and sends it to the certification ECU.
Front Door Outside Handle
Transmits the request signal from the outside oscillator via the built-in antenna, forming a detection area.
Outputs the lock switch condition (ON/OFF) to the certification ECU. [Door Lock Function]
Has a built-in touch sensor. [Door Unlock Function]
Luggage Room Inside/Outside Antenna
Transmits the request code from the certification ECU, forming detection areas inside/outside the luggage room.
Back Door Lock/Opener Switch
Sends the back door lock switch ON signal to the certification ECU.
Sends the back door opener switch ON signal to the certification ECU via the main body ECU.
Wireless Answer-back Buzzer
Sounds during answer-back or warnings under the control of the certification ECU.
Smart Entry & Start System Components 2
Smart Entry & Start System Main Component Functions 2
Components Main Function
Main Body ECU (Instrument Panel Junction Block Assembly)
Drives the power source (ACC,IG1,IG2) relays.
Sends the engine start request signal to the engine ECU.
Sends the ON/OFF signals of each door courtesy light switch to the certification ECU, etc. via LIN communication.
Confirms completion of all-door lock/unlock operation and drives the flasher relay. [Answer-back Function]
Flasher Relay
Blinks the hazard warning lights during answer-back under the control of the main body ECU. [Answer-back Function]
IG1,IG2,ACC Relay
Turns ON/OFF under the control of the main body ECU, supplying power to each system.
Engine Switch
Sends the engine start, IG ON and ACC ON signals to the main body ECU.
Receives the ID code when the electronic key battery is depleted and sends it to the certification ECU.
ID Code Box
Receives commands from the certification ECU and sends immobiliser set/unset commands to the engine ECU.
Shift Lock ECU
Detects the shift position "P" condition.
Sends the shift position signal to the main body ECU.
Steering Lock ECU
Receives the "steering unlock" signal from the certification ECU and releases the steering lock.
Receives the "steering lock" signal from the certification ECU and locks the steering.
Combination Meter [Built-in Meter ECU]
Provides warnings (meter information display and single-tone buzzer in the meter) according to operation command signals from the certification ECU.
Displays information when a malfunction occurs in the Smart Entry & Start System.
Sends the vehicle speed signal to the main body ECU.
Stop Light Switch
Detects that the brake is depressed (ON) and outputs it to the main body ECU.
